props.heading: Church Ambassador Teams
props.lede: One Sunday a month we worship at another church in Grand Rapids. We do not go to recruit and we do not go to correct. We bring prayer, love, an offering, and people to say out loud that we are one Church in this city.

props.heading: We go as guests, not as visitors.
props.subline: The fourth Sunday of the month
props.body:
Every month one church from thechurchmap.com becomes the church we pray for. Our whole congregation prays for them by name all month long. These are ordinary members praying, not just our staff.

On the fourth Sunday a team from New Life goes to their service. We sit in their pews and sing their songs. We worship under their pastor. We bring a letter telling them what we prayed for and a gift toward the work they are already doing. We stay in touch after we leave. Their pastor stays in our prayers.

facts.label: When
facts.value: The fourth Sunday of the month

facts.label: How long
facts.value: One service — you are home by lunch

facts.label: What we bring
facts.value: Prayer, love, an offering, and people

facts.label: Who can go
facts.value: Anyone. Families, students, first-timers — you are a guest, not a volunteer

cards.title: We choose the church
cards.text: One church in Grand Rapids, picked a month ahead off the church map, and we ask their pastor what they would want prayed for.

cards.title: The whole church prays
cards.text: They go up on the screen on Sunday and into the reminders our Dream Team gets all month. Ordinary members praying, not just staff. You do not have to go to be part of this.

cards.title: A team goes on the fourth Sunday
cards.text: We arrive together, sit in their pews, sing their songs, and let their service be their service.

cards.title: We hand over the letter and the gift
cards.text: A written letter of gratitude and an offering toward the work they are already doing — given to their leader, in person.

cards.title: We stay connected
cards.text: Their pastor stays on our prayer list, and their church stays on the map. This is not a one-Sunday relationship.

props.title: One Body. One witness.
props.body:
Two of our five commitments are to unite the Church and to reveal Jesus to this city. Those are easy things to agree with and hard things to actually do. Doing them means going somewhere that is not ours and being glad about it.

Grand Rapids does not need one more church competing for a Sunday morning. It needs churches that pray for each other by name and can prove it. That is all this is — the vision with a date on the calendar.

props.title: Pick a month.
props.body: Tell us you want to go. We will let you know the church, the time, and what to expect. You can come once or come every month.
